summary: The first realtime speech provider remains undecided and requires quality-first evaluation with interruption tests.
The HTTPS approach is resolved in favor of a fixed public IPv4, Caddy and Let's Encrypt short-lived IP certificate; real mobile secure-context and microphone acceptance remains an execution gate.

source.ref: Phase 1 entry gate approved and server validation completed

summary: The broad runtime technology-stack question was split and resolved for mobile, cloud, Agent, engineering and workstation baselines; data and infrastructure choices remain separate open questions.
Default retention periods and the confirmation threshold for long-term memory remain undecided.
The identity mechanism is resolved for the first version with one allowlisted email, short-lived one-time codes, revocable server-side sessions and email-based recovery.
The mobile text event transport is resolved with HTTPS commands and SSE delivery; workstation and realtime voice transports remain separate later-stage questions.
The monorepo question is resolved: one repository contains three independently deployable applications.

source.ref: Technology baseline continuation confirmed in project discussion

summary: The delivery sequence is resolved: cloud foundations first, then mobile-integrated vertical slices, with the workstation phase later.

source.ref: Technology baseline continuation confirmed in project discussion

summary: The primary data question is resolved with PostgreSQL, Alembic, pgvector and a defined backup baseline; retention, object storage, queueing and checkpoint lifecycle remain separate open questions.
The durable queue and scheduler question is resolved for the first version with Procrastinate, PostgreSQL-backed Jobs, database-driven reminder scans, at-least-once delivery and idempotent consumers.
LangGraph PostgreSQL checkpoint table initialization, schema ownership, retention and cleanup require a focused technical spike before implementation.
The workstation long-lived bidirectional transport, device authentication and lease renewal protocol remains undecided and is intentionally separate from the mobile SSE decision.
DeepSeek V4 Pro is selected, but production credentials and real Chinese quality, streaming cancellation, tool-call and structured-output tests remain required before the text slice can pass.

The temporary trusted HTTPS entry uses public port 18443 and now includes an interactive microphone probe whose virtual-device browser path passes without retaining audio; real-phone permission behavior and a production certificate renewal path that respects the high-port boundary remain unresolved.
